15: As armies mass for a final battle that will decide the fate of the world--and powerful, ancient forces of Light and Dark compete to determine the outcome--one member of the Fellowship of the Ring is revealed as the noble heir to the throne of the Kings of Men. There can be no triumph without loss. No victory without suffering. No freedom without sacrifice.
271: A team of elite commandos on a secret mission in a Central American jungle come to find themselves hunted by an extraterrestrial warrior.
527: Two sisters move to the country with their father in order to be closer to their hospitalized mother, and discover the surrounding trees are inhabited by Totoros, magical spirits of the forest. When the youngest runs away from home, the older sister seeks help from the spirits to find her.
He's your friendly neighbourhood forest spirit!
783: Ash Williams and his girlfriend Linda find a log cabin in the woods with a voice recording from an archeologist who had recorded himself reciting ancient chants from "The Book of the Dead." As they play the recording an evil power is unleashed taking over Linda's body.
1039: A woman, accidentally caught in a dark deal, turns the tables on her captors and transforms into a merciless warrior evolved beyond human logic.
The average person uses 10% of their brain capacity. Imagine what she could do with 100%.
1295: Babe, fresh from his victory in the sheepherding contest, returns to Farmer Hoggett's farm, but after Farmer Hoggett is injured and unable to work, Babe has to go to the big city to save the farm.
In the heart of the city, a pig with heart.
Fugly Floom, the Speechless Man in Hotel
1551: When teenage geniuses Mitch Taylor and Chris Knight, working on an advanced laser project, learn that the military wants to use it as a weapon, they decide to thwart the plan.
When he gets mad, he doesn't get even… he gets creative.

You're either S.W.A.T. or you're not.

2319: The sole survivor of an interplanetary rescue mission lands on the planet of the apes, and uncovers a horrible secret beneath the surface.
The bizarre world of "Planet of the Apes" was only the beginning...

3343: A stern Russian woman sent to Paris on official business finds herself attracted to a man who represents everything she is supposed to detest.

Broadway's barest, rarest, unsquarest love play.

We don't stop playing because we grow old, we grow old because we stop playing.

4879: Three young children accidentally release a horde of nasty, pint-sized demons from a hole in a suburban backyard. What follows is a classic battle between good and evil as the three kids struggle to overcome a nightmarish hell that is literally taking over the Earth.

Based on the incredible true story that inspired Moby Dick
5391: At a weekend gathering, a man tells a woman that they had spent time there together a year prior. But, the woman has no recollection whatsoever and is convinced that he is simply fabricating the encounter. X – The man with the Italian Accent
M – The Other Man with the Lean Face, The Husband
5647: In a time of war and disease, a young officer gallantly tries to help a young woman find her husband.
5903: When a Soviet submarine gets stuck on a sandbar off the coast of a New England island, its commander orders his second-in-command, Lieutenant Rozanov, to get them moving again before there is an international incident. IT'S A PLOT! ...to make the world die laughing!!
6159: Four stowaways get mixed up with gangsters while running riot on an ocean liner.

For 10% of the action and a red Ferrari, she'd con her own grandmother.

Being Terrified is Just the Beginning!

You don't choose a life. You live one.

Those who can't earn a living must find another way to provide

Noam Chomsky and the PRINCIPLES of CONCENTRATION of WEALTH & POWER

Carter Nix / Cain / Dr. Nix / Josh / Margo
7951: Will Lockhart arrives in Coronado, an isolated town in New Mexico, in search of someone who sells rifles to the Apache tribe, finding himself unwillingly drawn into the convoluted life of a local ranching family whose members seem to have a lot to hide.

Rip-roaring adventure on the old China Coast.

When did you first fall in love with hip-hop?

The incredible true story of gold medal champion Jesse Owens

Live as one. Die as one.

9743: Following the death of his wife, a renowned musician ostracises himself from the outer world and dedicates his life to music. However, his life changes when a young man approaches him to learn music.
9999: A documentary on seniors at a high school in a small Indiana town and their various cliques.
Remember high school? It's gotten worse.
10255: Roseanne looks forward to her high school graduation and leaving her dysfunctional home life behind -- until a brutal act brings doom to all involved.
10767: On a trekking trip, an introverted Naina falls for a charming ex-classmate, whose thirst for adventure drives them apart. Years later, their paths cross again.
One cannot be wise and old without being young and crazy.
11023: A working-class woman is willing to do whatever it takes to give her daughter a socially promising future.
Sure - I like a good time!
11279: While a group of young actors rehearse a new musical about a mass murderer, a notorious psychopath escapes from a nearby insane asylum.

Discover a world of wishes and wonder.

Summer 2008: The gang of Punjab arrives with a bang!

He's so far undercover he may never get back.

Mankind May Fall. Heroes Will Rise.

Ajax and Argo, The Siamese Cyclops
Ajax and Argo, The Siamese Cyclops

Real Friends Do the Dirty Work.

Music is the strongest form of magic

18447: A young immigrant comes to America in the 60s and is caught up in the counterculture movement which tests his bonds of friendship and love.
All the boys love Georgia... and Georgia loves all the boys!
18703: A chronicle of the life, work and mind that created the Cthulhu mythos.

All this to stop the investigation into the death of Colonel Milan.

That is until he experiences something he had never experienced before.

In the heart of Times Square, a poor girl becomes famous, a rich girl becomes courageous, and both become friends.
19983: When an aspiring young artist is forced to join her high school track team, she uses it as an opportunity to pursue the girl she's been harboring a long-time crush on. But she soon finds herself falling for an unexpected teammate and discovers what real love feels like.

There Must Be Something In The Water.

On the street, the real trick is staying alive.

They escape and set off on a quest to find the jewel and rescue Canary.

They don't want you to believe what she saw.

Will Reza's prison break transform him into an unlikely pillar of the community?

Agha's wife and relatives leave him during this downfall.

A tragic incident pits him on a collision course with the ruthless and borderline-manic cop Daya.

25103: Maddy impersonates Rajeev, the person his love interest, Reena, is about to marry and attempts to woo her. However, he is unprepared for the moment when the truth will be revealed.

Some fight to win. He fought to live.

They came in peace but left in pieces.

He walks amidst faith, delusion, dream and trance, followed by others.

Small Town. Big Libido. Epic Comedy.
27151: Sathyajith, Assistant Commissioner of Police, along with his team is assigned to handle controversial and complicated cases. One day, while fishing on a lake side, a man finds a garbage bag trapped inside his net.

56 DAYS | 56 DOLLARS | HOW DO YOU SURVIVE?

27919: While there is an old-fashioned feel to the story telling, it moves along new paths that are twisted enough to keep us interested and also has us clenching our fists.

He’s not the only one watching…

Fighting, killing, maiming. Agent Orange and the torture cages were the easy part!

WEIRD! Ghoulish atomic beasts who live off human blood!
30223: In Hyderabad, two police officers Abhay and Adhya join forces to solve a series of kidnappings of which all the victims are girls, with one other interesting commonality.

What lies behind us is tiny compared to what lies within us.

Anjali / Vishakha / Kajal / Hansa / Mallika / Pooja / Rajni / Nandini / Bhavna / Jhankhana / Sanjna / Chandrika
